scope: Bounded primary-source and Europe PMC candidate searches after the discovery candidate list was frozen. Search absence is not a novelty certificate.
queries: sponge/candidate-audit/candidates.json in the private local research packet; six primary captures are retained there with hashes and URLs.

candidates.evidence: A primary lamin-A-interactor screen reports CMTM5 among interactors found in all four screens and validated on retest.
candidates.implication: Do not claim CMTM5 as a newly discovered lamin-binding protein. The acute relative-LMNB1/RNA pattern was not established by that paper.

candidates.evidence: The retained query returned unrelated or broad disease-expression papers; no primary paper was retained that establishes this exact LMNA/lamina/cardiomyocyte pattern.
candidates.implication: Candidate-level prior art remains unresolved; absence from this search is not novelty.

candidates.evidence: The bounded search surfaced a 2026 HGPS fibroblast extracellular-matrix paper, but the captured search result does not establish this candidate's acute cardiomyocyte LMNB1/RNA pattern.
candidates.implication: Treat as prior-art lead requiring full primary-text and supplement review before any novelty wording.

candidates.evidence: No retained primary source established the exact LMNA/lamina/cardiomyocyte pattern in the bounded search.
A human myocardial transcriptomic study stratified by cardiomyopathy genotype lists PIANP among the LMNA-group regulated secretory genes.
candidates.implication: Do not claim PIANP as a new LMNA-cardiomyopathy expression association. The relative-LMNB1 signal pattern remains untested there.

candidates.evidence: Retained hits concerned other tissues or general expression models; no primary paper established this exact lamina/cardiomyocyte pattern.
Retained hits included broad cardiovascular biomarker work but no primary lamina mechanism or exact candidate pattern.
The bounded search returned ZFTA-RELA ependymoma work, not an LMNA cardiomyocyte mechanism.
candidates.implication: Do not describe the gene itself as novel; keep any lamina-pattern lead exploratory.

candidates.evidence: A primary study reports FYCO1 control of cardiomyocyte autophagy and cardiac function under pressure overload.
candidates.implication: Do not claim a new FYCO1 cardiac-function or autophagy discovery. The LMNB1/RNA pattern was not validated by that study.

candidates.evidence: Kubben et al. (2012), main Table 1, explicitly lists mouse Lysmd3 (Entrez80289) as MEF A&P Common, with progerin/control fold change1.13 and P-up classification. The original audit missed the mixed-case symbol in an already-retained table; exact error cause is unresolved, although uppercase-only matching would miss it.
candidates.implication: Retire new lamin-target or new lamin/progerin relation claims. Any human cardiomyocyte expression pattern remains a context-specific hypothesis requiring independent data.

known_class_boundaries: Gained LADs, LAD-boundary behavior, and LINC/DNKASH-dependent chromatin preservation are established prior-art classes in the retained packet.
DNKASH tracks in this campaign are chromatin context only; no DNKASH RNA rescue measurement exists.
The independent H222P comparison tests RNA direction only and is not matched biological replication or mechanistic validation.
